title: Pure-loss bosonic dynamic capacities: EPnI consequences and consumed-key secrecy accounting
strongest_verified_unconditional_claims: Literal PDC consumed-register secrecy plus reliability at zero input energy forces d_M*d_TA=1 eventually for vanishing errors, with exact finite bound 1<=1/(d_M*d_TA)+(epsilon_sec+epsilon_rel)/2.
OTP generated-message secrecy is exact, but literal joint consumed-key secrecy has minimum unhalved trace norm 2*(1-1/d) for all comparison public marginals.
Corrected private information inequalities charge consumed private/key and public registers with valid exact chain identities; pure refinement is valid for degradable channels.
Displayed quantum and corrected generated-secret private unions are achievable inner bounds under finite gross net-resource conventions and the stated average optical input cost.

Generic regularized entropic outer bounds, scalar convexity/concavity, common-parameter reduction conditional on its entropy premise, cone inverses, closure and ordered energy approximations are valid.
Exact quantum/private conversion cones at N=0; exact both regions at eta=1; exact repaired-private region at eta=1/2 do not require EPnI.

strongest_verified_conditional_claim.premise: For every finite n and every finite-energy n-mode rho, H(L_t^(tensor n)(rho))/n>=g(t*g_inverse(H(rho)/n)) for t in [0,1], with an independent vacuum environment and arbitrary internal multimode entanglement.
strongest_verified_conditional_claim.conclusion: For eta in [1/2,1] and 0<=N<infinity, the manuscript CQE region and explicitly repaired generated-secret RPS region are exactly the displayed closed unions over lambda in [0,1].
strongest_verified_conditional_claim.primary_statement_match: Pinned OpenAI Theorem 1.1 / Corollary 1.2 state a sufficient premise; their labels are not independent validation.

exact_remaining_dependency_gap: The entire upstream EPnI proof Sections 3–6 and its Lean kernel build/axiom report were not independently established in this adversarial assignment. This review cannot alone certify unconditional global capacity equalities. No EPnI counterexample was found or asserted.

non_substantive_wording_points.point: At t=0 increasing must mean nondecreasing.
First refinement gain is I(Z;B|XY); the B-minus-E gain applies to the last two bounds. Both needed monotonicities hold.

scope_limits: eta=0 and eta<1/2 lie outside the main capacity theorems.
No semantic-security upgrade, secrecy after revealing consumed key, peak/per-codeword energy constraint, free feedback, two-way assistance, superlinear catalyst or zero-gross-seed assertion.
No generic optimization/additivity theorem is inferred from the formulas; no novelty or publication clearance assessed.

reproduction.interpretation: Exact finite controls corroborate the analytical proofs; no finite sampling is a proof of EPnI or universal quantum inequalities.
